## Why it matters

Année Politique Suisse organizes contemporary Swiss political history through linked articles, topics, actors, and dossiers rather than isolated keyword hits.

It helps researchers trace debates, institutions, and policy processes across federal and cantonal politics with curated, citable summaries.
